subject: Mutual action plan: initial draft, timeline choice & stakeholder confirmations

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Mutual action plan — initial draft & timeline options (Novus Health)
Attachments: RDW_Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for a thoughtful discovery session earlier today. I captured the key outcomes in an initial mutual action plan (attached) and sketched two timeline options so we can pick the cadence that matches Novus Health priorities and compliance gating. Quick ask below: please confirm the internal Novus stakeholders (names + roles) we should include on the MAP and which timeline you prefer.

High-level milestones (proposed):
- Milestone 1 — Security intake & questionnaire complete (Novus: Security; Redwood: Stephanie) — dependency: SOC 2 evidence packet
- Milestone 2 — Pilot deployment (integration + sample data) — dependency: data access agreement + test dataset
- Milestone 3 — Evaluation & quality review (apps + feedback loop) — owners: Novus product, Redwood solutions
- Milestone 4 — Contract & procurement signoff — owners: Novus procurement, Redwood sales

Two timeline options included in the sheet:
- Option A (Accelerated) — 6 weeks to pilot (target close ~ Aug 28) — assumes security questionnaire is fast-tracked and we get test data within 1 week
- Option B (Measured) — 10 weeks to pilot (target close ~ Sep 25) — allows 2–3 week security review and procurement windows

Dependencies we flagged: SOC 2 evidence, test data extraction, procurement timelines, and a technical integration slot from Novus infra.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm internal Novus stakeholders and which timeline (A or B) you prefer
2) We’ll schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff (we can do Tue 8/10 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 8/12 14:00–14:30 PT) — I included a Calendly link in the doc
3) Redwood will update the MAP with named owners and circulate V1.1 for signatures

Please let me know by EOD Thu 8/5 if you can — that will help lock resources on our side.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

  - Priya Nair <priya.nair@novushealth.com> (Infrastructure) — integration POC

1) SOC 2 evidence — our security team will need a copy to run an initial gap analysis (they usually ask for sysadmin contacts and retention policy details)
2) Test data — we can provide a synthetic subset but it will require a one-week window to anonymize

I can do the MAP kickoff — Tue 8/10 10:00 PT works for me. Please send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the clear milestones. Marcus is CC'd here and will jump in on the security specifics.
